name: Rending Draft
description: Tear a violent draft through the foe's stance and leave it reeling from the blow.

name: Scything Draft
description: Scythe a wide blade of air across the foes' knees and break their formation.

name: Tempered Breath
description: Temper the breath until it runs like steel through the chest and the qi follows it.

name: Skyward Reading
description: Read the winds from ground to cloud and tell where a great storm is gathering.

name: Wrecking Squall
description: Break a squall over the foes that wrecks formations and flings loose gear in every direction.

name: Howling Mantle
description: Wear a howling mantle of wind so loud and dense that few blows can pass it.

name: Buffeting Gale
description: Buffet a single foe with a gale that pins it to the ground and batters it senseless.

name: Roaring Surge
description: Surge forward on a roaring column of wind and strike the foe with the whole rush.

name: Skycleave Cyclone
description: Cleave the sky with a spinning cyclone and bring its full length down across the field.

name: Hollowing Vortex
description: Hollow out a great vortex that drinks in blows and gale alike and hurls them outward.

name: Raging Flash
description: Flash across the field in one raging motion and land a gale-driven blow on the chosen foe.

name: Windruin Tempest
description: Gather the school's ruinous wind into a single tempest and loose it on the foes.

name: Calamity Gale
description: Unleash a gale of calamity whose ruin reaches the destructive ceiling of a Xiantian cultivator and flattens an army's ranks.

name: Squall Lash
description: Lash a hard cord of squall wind from the core at a foe across the field.

name: Thundering Breath
description: Draw a thundering breath through the core and let its qi surge into every limb.

name: Hurricane Reading
description: Read the whole turning body of the storm and learn where its eye and wall will pass.

name: Shearing Draft
description: Shear a vicious draft across a foe's guard to split its stance and open the body.

name: Hurricane Mantle
description: Wear a mantle that turns like a hurricane's wall and flings off all but the heaviest blows.

name: Typhoon Palm
description: Slam a palm that carries a small typhoon into the foe and drives it through the air.

name: Sweeping Hurricane
description: Sweep a hurricane's width of wind across the field and tear every foe from its place.

name: Whirling Descent
description: Spin down from the sky in a whirling fall and strike the foe with the weight of a storm.

name: Eyewall Cyclone
description: Raise the wall of a cyclone about the foes and close it in until nothing inside stands.

name: Eyeblink Flash
description: Flash into the still eye of the storm and turn aside every blow aimed at the user's former place.

name: Unmaking Draft
description: Pass a draft through the foe's body that unmakes its flesh from within and ignores all guards.

name: Typhoon Crown
description: Set a crown of typhoon wind over the field and press every foe beneath it to the ground.

name: Core Hurricane
description: Loose the core's whole hurricane in one stroke whose ruin reaches the ceiling of a Core cultivator's might over a great field.

name: Skybreaking Typhoon
description: Break the sky with a typhoon that tears down walls and scatters hosts to the ceiling of a Core cultivator's power.

name: Crushing Draft
description: Throw a draft with the weight of the high air behind it and knock the foe from its stance.

name: Celestial Breath
description: Take a breath drawn from the highest air and let divine energy run clear through the user's body.

name: Heavenly Reading
description: Read the winds of the whole sky and learn the position of every power moving beneath them.

name: Purging Gale
description: Blow a purging gale through allies to scour curse and taint and the backlash of a Qi Deviation.

name: Heavenly Mantle
description: Spread a heavenly mantle of wind over the user and nearby allies that turns heavy blows aside.

name: Tempest Fist
description: Slam a palm that drives a whole tempest into the foe's body and hurls it away.

name: Judgment Cyclone
description: Call a cyclone of judgment down upon a host and strip the ground bare beneath it.

name: Heavenpierce Gale
description: Drive a gale narrowed to a spear of the sky through armor and shield and the foe behind them.

name: Divine Vortex
description: Open a vortex of divine wind that grinds foes inward and holds them in its turning.

name: Heaven Flash
description: Flash from one end of the field to the other in the time of a single breath.

name: Mending Heavenwind
description: Pour the divine wind through wounded allies and close hurts of the flesh and lungs together.

name: Tempest Edict
description: Decree the tempest upon the field so that every foe is held down while the wind strikes.

name: Heavenwind Dominion
description: Hold the whole field under the heavenwind so that foes break upon it and the user stands untouched.

name: Heavenrend Gale
description: Rend the heavens with a gale whose ruin reaches the destructive ceiling of a Divine cultivator over a vast stretch of land.

name: Skyfall Typhoon
description: Drop the sky as a typhoon and crush ground and host alike up to the Divine tier's ceiling of ruin.
